summary: Fence light-node program credentials and signed graph effects with durable execution authority and ordered home acknowledgements

replay.detail: Local execution admission and home request receipts use fresh versioned authoritative tables; existing full-node run capabilities keep their graph-checked reader and issuer.

schema.detail: The session journal retains exact execution bindings, hashed local credentials, revoked revision fences, pending proposals and per-epoch authority change/ACK floors. The home retains admitted execution keys, graph revision snapshots, epoch fences and atomic effect response receipts. Explicit caps provide backpressure instead of dropping authority or replay evidence.

rules.detail: An opt-in program issuer waits for its own home admission acknowledgement before minting, and predecessor revocation acknowledgement before replacement. Native proposals require fresh validation after ACK. Request-specific host signatures bind identity, epoch, method, target, payload digest, stable request ID and bounded expiry. Home graph effects recheck current authority and commit their retry receipt under the same writer as revocation. Authenticated attempt context is captured before batching and restored inside the actual writer transaction, including projection-drain actions; cancellation or retry cannot pass a submitting-thread-only check. A run cannot impersonate an agent or person.

compatibility.detail: Old binaries do not enforce the new authority and receipt fences. Do not roll them back over an enabled light-node journal; retain its versioned state and roll forward. Unconfigured full nodes do not switch credential formats or topology.

downtime.detail: No deployment or production light-node cutover is performed by this change.

manual.detail: Added real SQLite/store regressions for offline restart, ordered revoke/ACK/reoffer, exact native identity, tampering, key/epoch refusal, ended attempts, delayed effects and exact-once retry. The integration owner must execute Linux checks and obtain an exact-head review; no verification or CPU/offload result is claimed by this fragment.

recovery.detail: Authority changes replay until durably acknowledged. ACK advances the compact floor but never auto-admits a pending native proposal. Already admitted request retries recover their original response even after revocation or assertion expiry. Cross-shard messages and local-observation claims remain on dedicated effect adapters, not an unauthenticated forwarding fallback.
